column3: In /home/mesh-home/tiny-fleet, assemble one publishable closeout package from all current evidence: canonical README/summary, evidence index, repository manifest and hashes, reproducibility commands and outputs, explicit PASS/OPEN/BLOCKED/NOT-CONCLUDED verdicts, limitations, and exact next actions; reconcile every declared direction against artifacts, fix presentation/documentation gaps without inventing results, run focused repository checks, commit and push, and report the final revision plus unresolved blocks.
